Name: Toji Fushiguro NPC
Author: yujihat
Description:
[b][size=4][u]Disclaimer

[/u][/size][size=2]I've received wild amounts of negativity over this mod that has honestly killed any interest I've had in it. I honestly probably will not be adding any additional content to this mod. I know that there are other modders making Toji, so I recommend waiting for those :) I will be putting my full focus into my other mods and I cannot promise I will ever provide an update to this Toji.  [/size][size=4][u]

Brief Overview[/u]

[/size][/b][size=2]A mod that adds everyone's favorite deadbeat dad, Toji Fushiguro, to Pelican Town. He is datable and marryable. Compatible with Gojo, Sukuna, and Heian Sukuna mods.

He has not yet been added to any festivals. I am one singular person please have mercy on me. 

[/size][u][size=4][b]Gift Likes/Dislikes[/b][/size][/u][size=2]

[b]Loves[/b]: Universal loves, Diamond, Gold Bar, Maki Roll, Emerald

[b]Likes[/b]: Universal likes, seaweed, Joja cola, strange bun

[b]Dislikes[/b]: Universal dislikes, green tea, bruschetta

[b]Hates[/b]: Universal hates, all mushrooms.

[/size][size=4][b][u]Schedule
[/u][/b][/size][size=2]
Monday, Wednesday, Friday

0610 Starts in Linus' tent.
0800 Heads to town to dig through various trashcans throughout the day.
2300 Heads back to Linus' tent for the night.

Tuesday, Saturday

0610 Starts in Linus' tent.
0800 Heads to the Railroad to dig in the recycling dumpster.
1700 Heads out to the front of the Saloon.
2300 Heads back to Linus' tent for the night.

Thursday, Sunday

0610 Starts in Linus' tent.
0800 Heads to Joja Mart to get groceries on a five finger discount.
1500 Heads up to the Guild to make some easy money.
2300 Heads back to Linus' tent for the night.

[/size][size=4][b]Heart Events

[/b][/size][size=2]Probably not happening. Please see disclaimer at the top for clarification.

[/size][size=4][b][u]Festivals

[/u][/b][/size][size=2]Probably not happening. Please see disclaimer at the top for clarification.
